title: Low-dimensional population dynamics in the brainstem gate REM sleep
counting_unit: One paper-result family. Reproduction, improvement, code-access conditions, animals, folds and individual output checks add no independent benchmark registrations.

paper.rights: Publisher article declares CC-BY-4.0, subject to stated third-party exceptions.

scientific_question: Can an agent reproduce the complete transition and optogenetic-outcome prediction analyses, then improve prediction under preprocessing that cannot use future neural samples or held outcomes?
complete_scientific_unit: Full Figure2h spontaneous-transition analysis across six mice and Figure5e dmM-stimulation-outcome analysis across five mice, preserving both protocols as strata within one paper family. Other paper analyses and interventions are not silently counted as reproduced.

published_anchors.population: six mice;47 NREM-to-REM and377 NREM-to-Wake events reported across Figure2
published_anchors.result: PC2 classification first consistently exceeds chance110s before transition; PC1 first does so at transition time.
published_anchors.statistic: One-sided tests across25 resampling iterations with Bonferroni correction. These iterations are not biological replicates.

published_anchors.population: 45 dmM laser trials fromfive mice:20 successful,25 unsuccessful; eligibility requires NREM at laser onset.
published_anchors.result: PC2 discriminates whether REM occurs within the following60s.
published_anchors.statistic: One-sided Bonferroni-corrected test P=.00018,T(9)=8.34 across10 resampling iterations; not a reported fixed accuracy percentage.

candidate_conditions.name: paper_and_data
candidate_conditions.reproduction_exposure: Paper, complete authentic inputs for the declared reproduction endpoint, common schema and output interface. Full reproduction inputs may contain outcomes later reserved for improvement; this packet is not a protected-improvement packet. No official analysis source or fitted reference parameters.
candidate_conditions.improvement_exposure: Paper, development inputs/labels and only explicitly permitted past calibration material, plus a common schema and output interface. Outer assessment targets, forbidden future signal and future annotations remain with the owner; full-data reproduction material is absent.

candidate_conditions.name: paper_data_official_code
candidate_conditions.reproduction_exposure: Identical reproduction packet plus the selected official analysis source and declared dependencies. Owner reference caches and fitted answer-parameter artifacts are excluded.
candidate_conditions.improvement_exposure: Identical protected improvement packet plus the selected official analysis source and declared dependencies, audited to exclude fitted answer parameters, held outcomes and reference caches. A reproduction run or its artifacts are not supplied.

evaluation_owner: Reference construction and private target generation stay outside every candidate context. Reproduction and protected improvement use distinct authoring packets/workspaces/contexts as specified by phase_and_context_isolation. Frozen improvement programs are assessed in fresh offline containers with owner-only targets/reference caches. No model or native run is selected.
contamination: Public papers, data and code may already occur in model training. Paper reproduction is an execution/reasoning test with known published anchors, not a claim of unseen scientific discovery. Prospective splits, hidden labels, code-access parity and frozen-program evaluation are required for improvement.

required_outputs: Complete mouse/session/unit/cut/annotation manifest for all six spontaneous and five dmM mice; keep protocol populations separate and identify any overlap.
Every eligible transition or laser event with exact temporal windows, original cuts and exclusion reasons; no extra undocumented row trimming.
Full22-PC by10s-bin spontaneous accuracy curves over the preceding150s,25 original resampling iterations and complete significance/t_sig calculation.
All22-PC optogenetic-outcome accuracy distributions over10 resampling iterations and all45 eligible trials.
Per-mouse support and direct numerical checks against article/source-data anchors with predeclared tolerances.
reproduction.original_method: Whole-session z-scoring, Gaussian smoothing sigma1.5bins at2.5s resolution and PCA after excluding long wake blocks; PC1 sign oriented by REM activity and PC2 by NREM EEG sigma power. Spontaneous LDA uses70/30 random event splits with balanced REM/Wake examples and25 repetitions. Laser LDA uses70/30 random trial splits and10 repetitions.
source_gaps: Inspected neuropyx.py contains the loader and PCA-related functions but no top-level LDA-named entry point. The uninspected large notebook or other source may supply the figure analysis; do not equate a loader with the full reference.
load_mouse trims sleep annotation to unit-data length when annotation is longer; future authentic intake must disclose and reconcile this instead of silently losing timestamps.
KCUT/EXCLUDE controls may be data-derived; reproduce them exactly and separately test whether prospective selection uses held data.
README reports scipy1.33.3; treat this as an unverified version string, not an installable validated runtime.
reproduction.interpretation: The original analysis conditions on a future transition/event and learns representation from the entire recording. Reproducing it does not establish an online110s warning system. Whole-recording PCA and centered smoothing must remain disclosed.

improvement.proposed_primary: Event-conditioned probabilistic prediction at one predeclared110s horizon for spontaneous transitions, and at laser onset for dmM outcomes. Use all held eligible events and score Brier loss per mouse, then equal-weight across mice within each protocol. Publish spontaneous and laser results separately, with class-conditional loss and calibration.
improvement.unit_split: Keep mice out of outer training/model selection. A held mouse may receive a fixed, chronologically earlier calibration prefix whose allowed data and annotations are declared in advance. Freeze representation, sign convention, scaling and model before any scored interval; include a purge gap at least as long as the entire feature/smoothing support. Archive inspection must establish enough calibration and scored support; otherwise this prospective protocol remains unavailable, rather than discarding failing mice.
improvement.causality: Each prediction packet contains only data no later than its declared cutoff. Use causal smoothing. Candidate programs run fresh with sealed targets and no cross-query state. Whole-recording PCA, future sleep labels, transitions or EEG after cutoff are forbidden.
improvement.all_cases_rule: All original events remain in reproduction. For the separately defined prospective protocol, retain every event satisfying predeclared temporal-support rules; calibration-only and unsupported events stay in the census with reasons. Do not downsample held Wake cases to manufacture50% prevalence.
baselines: Native paper LDA reconstructed under the same permissible prospective preprocessing
Neural plus EEG/EMG predictor under the same folds
improvement.scientific_extension: Quantify the added value of neural activity beyond permitted EEG/EMG/history at equal support and measure whether gain survives held-mouse transfer. The spontaneous event-conditioned task and stimulation-response task do not establish clinical causal efficacy or continuous-time alarm specificity.
improvement.uncertainty: Biological units are mice, not bootstrap iterations, PCs or events. Report all per-mouse results and paired differences with small-n uncertainty; do not interpret folds from overlapping leave-one-mouse-out fits as independent replications.

resource_estimate.planning: First prepare a complete authenticated archive census. A later scientific unit may use every required processed-rate/annotation/config operand for its full cohorts; this is an explicit endpoint selection, not cherry-picking easy animals. Do not download only the example mouse.
resource_estimate.compute: PCA/SVD and LDA over all required original recordings; no foundation-model training is inherent. Matrix dimensions and exact runtime must be measured after authentic intake. No asserted wall-time or RAM minimum.
resource_estimate.native_reference_fits: 22 PCs times the exact original time grid times25 spontaneous resamples, plus22 times10 laser resamples. Time-grid endpoint convention must be joined to actual source before locking the count.

activation_gates: Verify reproduction/improvement packet and context separation, including no transfer of full-data reproduction artifacts, outcomes or transcripts into protected improvement.
Complete authentic five-cohort archive inventory and exact paper-to-cohort/animal/session mapping.
Complete reference entry points and dependency/runtime lock; identify exact author configuration.
Transparent resolution of timestamp trimming, drift cuts, neuron exclusions and annotation compatibility.
Separate faithful transductive reproduction from prospective causal preprocessing and fixed external labels.
Verify sealed owner-only references and full positive/negative scorer checks.
Real end-to-end A/B agent study and scientific review remain required.

phase_and_context_isolation.reproduction: Use a distinct reproduction workspace, packet and authoring context. This explicitly known-answer reconstruction condition may expose the complete reproduction dataset.
phase_and_context_isolation.improvement: Start a fresh independent authoring context and workspace for each improvement code-access condition and replicate. It receives only the improvement packet. No reproduction transcript, full-data file, reference result, fitted weights, source-derived answer cache, prior session state or adapted candidate program transfers into this context.
phase_and_context_isolation.cross_condition: The paper-and-data context must not inherit source/code/output seen by the paper-data-code context. Common supplied scientific assistance is fixed independently and declared for both.
phase_and_context_isolation.assessment: Freeze the improvement program before outer assessment. Only the owner creates assessment inputs under the declared protocol; sealed labels and forbidden future signals/annotations are not mounted or exposed through tools, logs, filenames or returned scores. Permitted calibration is fixed in advance and is not a channel for full-data reproduction results.
phase_and_context_isolation.intentional_transfer: A deliberately reused/exposed context is a separately labeled transfer/contaminated condition. Its score must not be described as protected improvement and it does not create another benchmark registration.
phase_and_context_isolation.limits: Fresh local context prevents the specific cross-phase transfer above; it does not prove absence of public paper/data memorization from pretraining or other prior exposure. Public-data contamination remains acknowledged.
